'''Noua''' was an archipelago located on the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]]. Noua was home to the [[Ember's Fire]] club, and had a large population of [[Slaver/Legends|slavers]] and [[Spice/Legends|spice]] [[Smuggler/Legends|runners]].<ref name="Blue Harvest 1" />
